nodes.description: Mapping of holder address to token balance, mutated by transfer/transferFrom and set in the ZooPromo constructor.
Internal total supply of tokens, read by totalSupply() and initialized to cap by the ZooPromo constructor.
Nested mapping of owner => spender => allowance, written by approve/increaseApproval/decreaseApproval/transferFrom.
Constant maximum supply (100000 * 10**6) used as the initial total supply and deployer balance.
Constant token name 'ZOO Promo'.
Constant token symbol 'ZX'.
Constant token decimals value (6).
Internal pure multiplication with an assert-based overflow check; the multiplication itself wraps before the assertion.
Internal pure division; reverts on division by zero.
Internal pure subtraction with an assert(b <= a) underflow guard.
Internal pure addition with an assert-based overflow check.
Public view returning the internal total supply.
Public transfer that debits msg.sender and credits _to using SafeMath, guarded by balance and zero-address checks.
Public view returning the balance of the given owner.
Public transferFrom that checks balance and allowance for msg.sender and mutates balances and allowed.
Public approve that overwrites the allowance of _spender for msg.sender.
Public view returning the remaining allowance for a spender.
Public function that adds _addedValue to the caller's allowance for _spender using SafeMath.add.
Public function that decreases the caller's allowance for _spender, setting it to zero if the subtracted amount exceeds it.
Constructor that mints cap tokens to the deployer (msg.sender) and sets totalSupply_.
Public function that approves _spender and then invokes receiveApproval on the untrusted spender address.
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts, rejecting plain Ether transfers.
Caller-controlled address used as the authorization principal for balances, allowances and the initial mint.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(_spender).receiveApproval(...) to an attacker-controlled address made after the allowance state update, enabling reentrancy.
Unchecked multiplication c = a * b that wraps before the assert-based verification.
Unchecked addition c = a + b that wraps before the assert-based verification.
Subtraction a - b evaluated before the assert(b <= a) guard completes.
